Name: Application Load: Portal Home Page
Objective: Portal home page loads without error; primary navigation and main content are visible.
Step: Navigate to http://localhost:3000 and observe the landing page.
Expected Result: Portal home page loads without error; primary navigation and main content are visible.

Name: User Login: Valid Credentials
Objective: Valid registered email and password authenticate successfully.
Step: Open Log in, enter a valid registered email and password, and select Sign in.
Expected Result: User is authenticated and redirected to the user dashboard.

Name: User Login: Invalid Password Rejection
Objective: Valid email with incorrect password is rejected with an error message.
Step: Open Log in, enter a valid email with an incorrect password, and select Sign in.
Expected Result: Login is rejected; an error message is displayed and the user is not granted access to the dashboard.

Name: Navigation: Home to Course Catalog
Objective: From home, the course catalog link loads the catalog with available courses.
Step: From the portal home page, select the navigation link to the course catalog.
Expected Result: Course catalog page loads and displays available courses.

Name: Course Search: Single Keyword Query Returns Results
Objective: A single keyword search returns at least one matching course.
Precondition: The catalog or search control is available.
Step: Enter a single keyword (for example Testing) and execute the search.
Expected Result: Search results page loads and displays at least one matching course.

Name: Course Detail Page: Page Loads Without Error
Objective: A course detail page shows title, description, and enrollment action.
Precondition: Catalog or search results are visible.
Step: From the catalog or search results, select a course to open its detail page.
Expected Result: Course detail page loads without error; course title, description, and enrollment action are visible.

Name: Add Course to List: Confirmation Message Displays
Objective: Adding a course to the cart shows a confirmation message.
Precondition: A course detail page is open.
Step: From a course detail page, select Add to cart.
Expected Result: A confirmation message displays indicating the course was added successfully.

Name: User Dashboard: Loads With Correct User Data
Objective: Dashboard greeting, Recent activity, and Grades all show the correct user data.
Precondition: You completed the two-course checkout setup in the lab instructions so this user has enrolments and payment history.
Step: Sign in, open the dashboard, and review greeting, Recent activity, and Grades.
Expected Result: Greeting and Recent activity are correct. Grades should list enrolled courses. On this lab build Grades shows 0 courses and You have not received any grades yet. Log Fail.

Name: Navigation: Return to Home From Dashboard
Objective: From the dashboard, MindBridge in the header returns home.
Step: From the user dashboard, select MindBridge in the header.
Expected Result: Home page loads successfully without error.

Name: User Logout: Session Ends
Objective: Log out ends the session and returns an unauthenticated header.
Step: Select Log out in the page header and capture a screenshot of the result.
Expected Result: Session ends; the header again shows Log in and Register. Attach the screenshot in Zephyr and log Pass.
